manufacturers.name: NVIDIA
manufacturers.notes: NVIDIA packages are self-extracting wrappers; -s is silent, -clean removes previous profiles. Never force a reboot.

manufacturers.name: AMD
manufacturers.notes: AMD Adrenalin installer accepts -INSTALL -SILENT -NOREBOOT; always pair with -NOREBOOT.

manufacturers.name: Intel
manufacturers.notes: Intel DSA/Setup installers use -s --noreboot; Arc and integrated share the same silent flags.

manufacturers.name: Generic / Windows Update
manufacturers.notes: Handled by Windows Update / PnP (pnputil /scan-devices). No manufacturer download is offered.

notAutomated: BIOS/UEFI/firmware updates (no safe, verifiable silent path)
DDU or any aggressive driver cleanup / removal
Drivers without a valid WHQL/Authenticode signature
Forced reboots (the user decides when to restart)
Parallel driver installs (the global operation lock is respected)
